howto.text: FOXY PIES: the 2D pizza game rebuilt in 3D for the FOX world. Tap PUT ME TO WORK, or WATCH THE DEMO for one whole pizza. Dough: tap the yellow mark. Sauce + cheese: press and drag to the dashed line. Toppings: tap. Bake: hold, let go in the green. Slice: 4 drags through the middle. In the 3D world it drops into any building: Meru Town Square.dc.html?fill=burgers:pizza
